stepTitle: Calculate the retarding force due to the viscosity of the air layer between a cart and a level air track given the following information: air temperature is $$20**\circ\text{C},$$ the cart is moving at $$0.400\,\text{m/s},$$ its surface area is $$2.50\times10**{-2}\,\text{m}**2,$$ and the thickness of the air layer is $$6\times10**{-5}\,\text{m}.$$ Give the force to two decimal places (in $$\text{mN})$$.
